content: {"phoneNote":"The header stacks awkwardly with the directions link pushed far right on its own line, and the timeline bars for identical opening hours look like clickable buttons.","desktopNote":"The calm editorial layout works well in the hero, but the second mood image of a random mountain forest is disconnected from a medical pedicure studio, and the full-width schedule bars are overkill for three identical days.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":4,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":4,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Replace the second mood photo (mountain landscape) with an image relevant to foot care, hygiene, or a calm studio interior.","In the phone header, place the phone number and 'Navodila za pot' on the same horizontal row to make the top bar more compact.","Simplify the 'Kdaj vas sprejmem' schedule into a clean text list or table instead of heavy mauve bars that look like primary CTA buttons."],"blockers":[]}
